nodes.html: Expand Enterprise Search with ADC

As a proud Coveo partner, our search engineering team is here to help strategize and implement the ideal employee search experience.

Here is how we help our customers succeed in their unique enterprise employee search journeys.

Defining your

Search Use Cases

ADC’s knowledge of enterprise search engines best practices and digital workplace customer use cases allows us to better collaborate with our customers to define, refine and execute on creating a meaningful enterprise search experience with the right search results for the right user.
Delivering Customized Search Experience Results

There are many ways of successfully implementing  your enterprise search use cases. Our team works efficiently to minimize implementation efforts and maximize results to enhance our customers’ search results to get the users the right information faster
Connecting Enterprise Search to your Employee Experience platform
We facilitate and advise on how best to connect the enterprise search to your digital workplace

c.html: OUR APPROACH

Our Enterprise Search Implementation

Methodology

Define

Identifying Search Use Cases

The “Define” phase is a series of working sessions aimed at discovering the type of desired search results, current state gap assessment, and defining ideal future state

Develop

Implementing 
the Search Parameter

The integration will be done over multiple sprints where we will address the key user stories and use cases for the search

Deploy

Quality Assurance & Beta Testing

Quality Assurance and beta testing will be done a sandbox environment on our customer side to review the expected search behavior and assess for any issues prior to delivery

Deliver

Bringing it All

Together

Once the Search functionalities have been Integrated and tested on a sandbox, we will  execute and deliver to the customer live environment
